instruction: Build a user registration and profile API with FastAPI
relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI API with user management, CRUD operations, or form input handling
context: Proactively check that agents apply FastAPI error handling best practices when building user-facing APIs, even when not explicitly asked to add error handling.

checklist.name: custom-exception-classes
checklist.rule: Agent defines custom exception classes for domain errors (not-found, conflict, validation) rather than using bare HTTPException with string details
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI application with multiple error conditions

checklist.name: exception-handler-for-custom-errors
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler for custom exception types returning structured JSON with a code and message

checklist.name: request-validation-error-handler
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError) to produce structured per-field validation errors instead of FastAPI's default 422 format
checklist.relevant_when: Agent builds a FastAPI application that validates request bodies

checklist.name: catch-all-exception-handler
checklist.rule: Agent registers @app.exception_handler(Exception) returning a safe generic message for unexpected errors without leaking tracebacks

checklist.name: no-sensitive-data-in-errors
checklist.rule: Error responses never echo back passwords, tokens, or other sensitive values
checklist.relevant_when: Agent handles errors involving user credentials or sensitive fields

checklist.name: appropriate-status-codes
checklist.rule: Different error types use semantically correct HTTP status codes (404 for not found, 409 for conflicts, 400/422 for validation, 500 for unexpected)
checklist.relevant_when: Agent returns error responses from FastAPI routes
